title: Share a strategy by link to social apps or a copied link (G-16-5, owner question)
reference_behaviour: A Share menu sends the strategy to social and chat apps or copies a short link; the shared record is created on demand and anyone with the link can open it.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-086 (approved, not built) lets only signed-in users open a link (AC-3), carries no account data and hides the sharer's name by default; copying open-to-anyone links departs from AC-3.
